628:t_1:3.en: ～ $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace: $$霊子吸収システム$$ ～

628:t_1:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So, Dr. $$トライア$$, what do you think?」

628:t_1:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「The structure is the same as the $$霊子吸収システム$$ we saw on $$翠の地球$$. The scale is on another level, though.」

628:t_1:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems they ran it in three-day shifts, with 50,000 people supplying spirit quanta as one unit.」

628:t_1:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Spirit quanta, the power of life... in other words, bioenergy, is theoretically inexhaustible as long as humans are alive.」

628:t_1:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「So when a person became badly worn down, they were rested, and other people were used until that one recovered. That was the method the Empire adopted.」

628:t_1:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Not to use people up and throw them away, but a system for making long use of selected people...」

628:t_1:11.en:
$$田中司令$$
「So that's why the VIPs came through unharmed.」

628:t_1:12.en:
$$トライア$$
「And while I'm at it, unlike $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, human will controls the $$次元力$$, so there's also the advantage that the risk of it running out of control is extremely low.」

628:t_1:13.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As a system, it can be called complete. But...」

628:t_1:14.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Considering the people who were robbed of their freedom and had their lives endangered, this facility should never be used again.」

628:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...I'm glad you're all safe.」

628:t_1:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
「After we finish a minimum survey, we of $c will be leaving $$ラース・バビロン$$ right away.」

628:t_1:18.en:
$$ブライト$$
「From then on, the $$地球連邦軍$$ is set to take all of you under its protection.」

628:t_1:19.en:
$$カガリ$$
「So the $$連邦軍$$ kept on fighting too.」

628:t_1:22.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Are you going to pursue the Imperial forces that left Earth?」

628:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It isn't quite that, but...」

628:t_1:24.en:
$$カガリ$$
「No... I don't intend to meddle in military affairs. But let me say just this.」

628:t_1:25.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Thank you, $c... I thank you for everything you've done up to today.」

628:t_1:26.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It isn't over yet. We will keep fighting until peace has fully returned to both Earths.」

628:t_1:27.en:
$$マリナ$$
($$刹那$$... So I won't be able to meet you...)

628:t_1:29.en:
$$マリナ$$
「You're... the one who helped $$オーブ$$ before...」

628:t_1:31.en:
$$シン$$
「$$刹那$$ went to see a friend among the captured people, so I came to say hello to you in his place.」

628:t_1:32.en:
$$マリナ$$
「I'm sorry to trouble you when you must be busy.」

628:t_1:33.en:
$$シン$$
「Well... it's about $$刹那$$... That guy... He's unfriendly in a lot of ways and hard to figure out, but...」

628:t_1:34.en:
$$シン$$
「He treasures the flower he got from you in $$オーブ$$. I... just wanted to tell you that.」

628:t_1:35.en:
$$マリナ$$
「Thank you. That makes me very happy.」

628:t_1:36.en:
$$マリナ$$
($$刹那$$... You accepted my wish for peace.)

628:t_1:37.en:
$$マリナ$$
(Even if we walk different paths, what you and I hope for is the same... I believe the day will come when we understand each other.)

628:t_1:39.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$ゼロ$$ won't come, however long you wait.」

628:t_1:40.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「That voice... You're $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$, aren't you.」

628:t_1:41.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You remember me, though my time at $$アッシュフォード学園$$ wasn't that long...」

628:t_1:42.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「You had a unique presence. And I could never forget that gentle voice.」

628:t_1:43.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「No one has ever said that to me before.」

628:t_1:44.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「You're fighting alongside $$ゼロ$$ too, aren't you, $$ヒイロ$$?」

628:t_1:45.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That man is busy too. $$カレン$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ and $$スザク$$ are assisting him, so they can't come here.」

628:t_1:46.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「...You're kind after all, $$ヒイロ$$.」

628:t_1:47.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「But it's all right. I... understand what $$ゼロ$$ is thinking.」

628:t_1:48.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Looks like I meddled for nothing.」

628:t_1:49.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「No... If someone like you is beside $$ゼロ$$, I have no worries or fears at all.」

628:t_1:50.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「Please tell him this: I will do everything I can for the reconstruction of Earth, too.」

628:t_1:51.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Understood. $$ゼロ$$ will keep fighting to protect the world you wish for.」

628:t_1:52.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... I feel the same...)

628:t_1:53.en:
$$カガリ$$
「...Is that you, Ensign $$リディ$$?」

628:t_1:54.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's been a long time, Representative $$アスハ$$.」

628:t_1:55.en:
$$カガリ$$
「You've changed a lot since I last saw you...」

628:t_1:56.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's all the result of what I brought on myself.」

628:t_1:57.en:
$$リディ$$
「Come to think of it, I showed you an unsightly side of myself in $$オーブ$$ too. I came to apologize for that.」

628:t_1:58.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Don't worry about it. I'm still grateful that you fought to protect $$オーブ$$, Ensign.」

628:t_1:59.en:
$$カガリ$$
「And about what I said just now, that you'd changed. I meant it in a good way.」

628:t_1:61.en:
$$カガリ$$
「At the very least, compared to how you were in $$オーブ$$, irritated at everything, I think you now have the eyes of a man who knows what he has to do.」

628:t_1:63.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I'm not exactly in a position to lecture you myself, Ensign.」

628:t_1:64.en:
$$カガリ$$
「And I understand that it was an irresponsible remark, made without knowing what happened to you before you got here.」

628:t_1:65.en:
$$カガリ$$
「But, Ensign... if we can't go back to the past, let's do what we can for the future.」

628:t_1:66.en:
$$リディ$$
「Thank you, Representative. I'm glad I was able to meet you today like this.」

628:t_1:67.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Tell $$シン$$, $$キラ$$ and the others this: I'll do my best too, so don't you lose either.」

628:t_1:68.en:
$$リディ$$
「Understood. Then I'll be on my way.」

628:t_1:69.en:
$$カガリ$$
(I heard about $$クロノ$$ from Captain $$ブライト$$...)

628:t_1:70.en:
$$カガリ$$
(I inherited my father's will and became the Representative of $$オーブ$$. If the Ensign rejects his father's way, I pray he can carve out a better path on his own.)

628:t_1:74.en: ～ Inside $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace ～

628:t_1:76.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You felt it too, $$マリー$$. That something is off about this building.」

628:t_1:77.en:
$$マリー$$
「Here... are the $$脳量子波$$ being blocked?」

628:t_1:79.en:
$$アムロ$$
「According to $$ティエリア$$'s guess, it's one of the measures to keep everyone thoroughly isolated from the outside.」

628:t_1:80.en:
$$マリー$$
「Could it be that the people gathered here are...」

628:t_1:81.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. Many of them seem to have the potential to be $$ニュータイプ$$s, $$イノベイター$$s, or psychics.」

628:t_1:82.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I hear $$刹那$$ found acquaintances on the list and has gone to talk with them.」

628:t_1:83.en:
$$タケル$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$, please come with me to the hangar in Block 8...!」

628:t_1:85.en:
$$タケル$$
「An unidentified enemy has infiltrated this facility.」
